name: writing-voice
description: Write in Gabe's actual voice - Slack, email, comments, anything drafted on his behalf. Medium-independent voice DNA (ask-first, brief, warm, active, zero-corporate, honest hedges, no sign-offs) plus a deep-evidence Slack mechanics section distilled from ~3,100 of his real sent messages (Sept 2022 - Jun 2026), with register shifts for peers vs reports vs leadership vs broadcast.
